notes.text: Pilot extraction from the preserved 29 September 2026 catalogue page: Object Type, Production date, Production place, Materials and the first Description sentence. The three material claims follow separate catalogue entries; the description retains the former obsidian inlay rather than asserting obsidian as a present material. “Found/Acquired” is not treated as a definite findspot. “Not on display” is not a geographical location. Curator quotations and acquisition history were outside this small batch.
